checks.name: Shared collision boxes retract both camera uses before the near plane intersects a wall
Thin-post release uses time hysteresis without skipping the post or repeatedly snapping out
Narrow corridor, overhead deck, reverse approach and turning fixtures preserve physical inputs
Actual vendor OrbitControls rotate an independent desired camera without inventing zoom at an obstruction
World CG altitude, CG down-ray and estimated physical-envelope distances remain distinct on ground/roof/bridge/tilt
